notes: This phase adds the Compile layer that converts reviewed historical placement segments into stable v2 display X coordinates/ranges.
A reviewed Place may carry an exact display-axis anchor; otherwise a reviewed subregion produces a subregion range and center anchor.
If a Place has no reviewed display mapping, the compiler retains only the known macroregion instead of inferring a subregion from its name or a modern country.
Conflicts between a historical macroregion and a reviewed Place subregion are surfaced for review rather than silently corrected.
Existing Production historical data and the v1 renderer remain untouched.
